name: hackyard
description: Standard Hackyard post: calm, specific caption, the Hackyard CTA and brand hashtag.
guidance: Voice: premium, calm and specific. Show real builders and real work; no hype, no clickbait, no emoji strings. Never compare Hackyard to other products. Public calls to action say "Find your people. hackyard.org" (never app.hackyard.org). First line under 125 characters and works on its own. 3 to 8 hashtags, no hashtag walls.

description: Hackyard Build 2026 content: event hashtags and the event link.
caption_footer: Hackyard Build 2026. Find your people. hackyard.org
guidance: Build 2026 is Hackyard's hackathon. Link to hackyard.org/build2026 when pointing at the event (never build2026.hackyard.org).
